title: [FR-034] Verify and fix keyboard focus and saved-plan accessible name

KBD01 proposedP2: keyboard select corruptQAplan, activecheck, Tab VERIFY/MACHINE_OVERLAP Enter; taskscroll leaves focusedbutton offscreen (top -853 at640/-618 at1100), reproduced without QAbanner. Expected visible focus/control or suitable target.
KBD02 proposedP2: keyboard activecheck completion makes document.activeElement BODY, expected useful visible focus retained/restored; independent no-banner control required.
KBD03 proposedP2: .plan-list select no wrapping/forlabel/aria-label/labelledby/title, labels.length0, ARIAsnapshot barecombobox. Expected Chinese accessible name; optiontext not name.
These are concrete observed failures, not blanketcoveragegaps. Validate each independently; repairround1 only for reproducible confirmed items, max2 per defect. Preserve issue20 fixed UNKNOWN01 and allhistory/currentfacts. Fullrealidentity/UAT/allrule acceptance separate.
